# `summarize`

the summaries of a measure's values over a selection's members.

Version 2, scope `subject`. Run it with `nxr-neuro run summarize --dataset <folder> --subject <id> ...`; `nxr-neuro run summarize --help` prints the same options.

Examples:

```
nxr-neuro run summarize --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --over "cortex tiles" --of rest_kernel_phasegradient_alpha --measure phase_power --summaries "[mean, sd, median]"
```

## Inputs

| input | what it is | required |
|---|---|---|
| `over` | selection any, where {"name": "$over"} | yes |
| `of` | field any, where {"name": "$of"}, required false | no |
| `x` | measurement $measure, of of, over over (the measurement summarised, found by its key (the measure, of the field `of` (none: the members' own values), over `over`)) | yes |

## Parameters

Each is an option `--<name> VALUE` (dashes for underscores; the value is read as YAML) or `--set NAME=VALUE`.

| parameter | option | default | unit | choices | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `over` | `--over` | none | - |  | the selection whose members are summarised |
| `of` | `--of` | none | - |  | the field measured; null: the members' own values (area, n_elements) |
| `measure` | `--measure` | none | - |  | the measure summarised |
| `summaries` | `--summaries` | `["mean", "sd"]` | - |  | the summaries: mean, sd, median, mad, min, max, skewness, kurtosis, peak, count, percentile:P |
| `combine` | `--combine` | `each` | - | each, pool, mean | each = per row \| pool = the rows pooled \| mean = the mean of the rows' summaries |
| `ddof` | `--ddof` | `1` | - |  | the degrees of freedom removed from the sd's divisor |
| `name` | `--name` | `{of}_{measure}_{over}` | - |  | the stored statistic's name |

## The chain of nodes

| phase | node | in | with | out |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| after | [`measurement.summarize`](../nodes.md) | x=x | summaries=$summaries, combine=$combine, ddof=$ddof | statistic |

`before` steps run once, `chunks` steps run on every chunk of the recording, `after` steps run once on what the chunks accumulated.

## Outputs

| output | stored as |
|---|---|
| `statistic` | kind statistic, name $name, of of, over over, axes [{"name": "row"}, {"name": "summary"}] |

## Notes from the definition

```text
THE `summarize` OPERATION (was `statistic`): the values of a stored MEASUREMENT over a selection's members summarised into a STATISTIC, members -> statistic (one implementation, `nxr::measurement::summarize`; its
arithmetic is `stats.h`). The measure's values over the members (of a field; or the members' own: area, n_elements, when `of` is not given) are summarised per row (each), pooled, or as
the mean of the rows' summaries: mean, sd, median, mad, percentiles, min, max, skewness, kurtosis, peak, count (NaN members skipped and counted). Across an irregular set it is a `summary` statistic; never of a field.
The statistic is OF the field `of` and computed from the selection `over`; its axes are the row and the summaries, never the members (a per-member value is a measurement).

  nxr-neuro run summarize --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --over "cortex tiles" --of rest_kernel_phasegradient_alpha --measure phase_power --summaries "[mean, sd, median]"
```
